maronite_rules.fact: Pastoral guidance specifies fasting until noon, weekday exceptions, Holy Week, Friday abstinence and June21-28 Apostles abstinence; observance is unknown.

maronite_start.fact: Entry into Lent on Feb15, followed by Ash Monday Feb16; Western Easter April5.

orthodox_calendar.fact: Great Lent begins Feb23 and Pascha is April12; not proof of local observance.

school_security.fact: National school closure announced March2. Publication hour is unknown; do not backdate it to opening.

school_remote.fact: Public-school remote learning from March10 in the following weeks; private-school arrangements vary. Seven-day transition window is a research specification, not the full closure duration.

weather.fact: Explicit ERA5 hourly reanalysis via Open-Meteo, explanatory observed stream.

issued_weather.fact: ECMWF IFS0.25 fixed previous_day1 lead, distinct from observed weather; earliest data availability/ingestion latency still requires operational verification.

air.fact: CAMS global atmospheric-composition archive via Open-Meteo; model-based exposure proxy, not a street monitor or vintage-guaranteed issued air forecast.

displacement.fact: Regional IOM displacement datasets identified but direct access returned403; not joined or interpolated into daily features.

calendar.fact: Public holiday dates; does not establish cafe closures.

prior_calendar.fact: Previously sourced Ramadan, Eid, Christian holidays and conflict dates; source-specific known-at controls apply.

known_at_limits: Lunar observance uses previously sourced declarations; calendars cannot identify religion.
Date-only announcements are conservatively excluded from same-day forecast changes.
Holiday eve/after and one-off news events are explanation-only here unless original announcement vintage is verified.
Archived previous_day1 weather is fixed-lead data, not a specific issuance timestamp; operational ingestion latency is not reconstructed.
Actual weather, air quality, forecast errors and retrospective regime labels are never presented as day-ahead inputs.
Geography is a three-region sensitivity analysis, not discovered branch locations.
